 DAZN will broadcast the Champions League match between RB Leipzig and Manchester City live, with a stream available on its platform.
 Talking points of the week: What has been happening at RB Leipzig and Manchester City?
 RB Leipzig have won three of their last five competitive matches. Most recently, they beat Schalke 04 2-0 away in the Bundesliga, having previously secured a 4-0 win over Elversberg. Their two defeats in that spell came against Real Madrid (4-1 in the Champions League) and Bayern Munich (6-1 in the Bundesliga). Leipzig scored twelve goals and conceded twelve across those five matches.
 In their last five competitive matches, Manchester City have won two, lost two and drawn one. They most recently lost 1-0 to Brighton in the Premier League, after beating AEK Athens 5-1 in the Champions League. City scored eleven goals and conceded six across those five matches.
